title: Architecture audit
objective: Audit the existing Gastro Growth Advisor architecture and establish a safe implementation baseline.

title: Design system hardening
objective: Harden the visual system, spacing, typography, responsive behavior and reusable UI primitives.

title: Landing conversion system
objective: Improve the GGA landing experience, messaging hierarchy and conversion paths for restaurant customers.

title: Restaurant onboarding
objective: Strengthen restaurant onboarding and data capture so the product receives actionable business context.

title: Dashboard foundation
objective: Harden the restaurant dashboard information architecture and operational UX.

title: AI advisor foundation
objective: Strengthen the provider-agnostic AI advisor layer and its data contracts.

title: Restaurant analysis engine
objective: Improve restaurant analysis workflows and structured recommendations.

title: Marketing action system
objective: Turn analysis into prioritized restaurant marketing actions and execution plans.

title: Social content engine
objective: Strengthen social media content generation and reusable campaign workflows.

title: Menu growth tools
objective: Build and harden menu analysis, pricing and promotion support workflows.
acceptance: No destructive writes occur without validation

title: Creative asset workflows
objective: Improve poster, campaign and promotional creative generation workflows.

title: Campaign orchestration
objective: Connect restaurant goals, campaigns, content and execution into a coherent workflow.

title: Analytics foundation
objective: Establish trustworthy product and restaurant growth analytics with explicit event contracts.
acceptance: Analytics failures do not break core UX

title: Billing and pricing hardening
objective: Harden pricing, subscription and billing boundaries without exposing payment secrets.

title: Security audit
objective: Audit authentication, authorization, secrets, dependencies and unsafe data flows.
acceptance: High severity dependency issues are addressed

title: Performance hardening
objective: Reduce unnecessary client work and improve production performance without regressions.

title: Accessibility regression
objective: Run a focused accessibility pass across the core GGA customer journey.

title: SEO and market readiness
objective: Harden SEO, metadata, structured content and German-market conversion readiness.
acceptance: Structured data is valid where used

title: Production QA
objective: Execute a production-grade regression pass across the full GGA experience.

title: Autonomous release readiness
objective: Verify Mission Engine continuity, observability, recovery and release readiness.
